title: In-memory counters guarded by a single lock
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the shared dict as a race or the per-call lock as a bottleneck. Every read and write of the dict happens under the same lock, increment returns the post-increment value read inside the critical section, and snapshot returns a copy so callers can never mutate or iterate the live dict while another thread updates it.
